text:
incident-bot: SEV alert: geo-routing anomaly detected for eu-west1 -> apac paths. Sudden probe-weight shift observed; elevated 5xx and latency spikes on /v1/generate (text-gen-v2). Auto-fallback not triggering. Pager: @olivia on-call.

anne: seeing the alert, I'm pulling the routing policy commits and probe logs. Give me a minute.

mike: there was a policy rollout at 2090012000: `weight-adjust-2029` that adjusted probe weighting between eu and apac. probes show 0.6->0.1 for eu probes around that time. suspect weight calc bug.

sam: customer impact: multiple EU tenants reporting >2s tail latency and intermittent 502/504s. No full outage but user-facing errors increased ~12%. Tracking impacted customer list in the SEV doc.

olivia: acknowledged, I'm going to disable geo-steering on the affected route (eu-west1) to force local egress while we triage. Applying emergency fallback now.

olivia: command:```bash
# disable steering for route /v1/generate in eu-west1
redwoodctl routing set --route /v1/generate --region eu-west1 --steering disabled --reason "emergency fallback - high errors"
```

incident-bot: Action applied: `steering disabled` on /v1/generate for eu-west1 (applied by olivia). Telemetry will reflect change in ~30s.

mike: rolling back `weight-adjust-2029` now to previous commit `weight-adjust-2028` - will watch probes.

mike: rollback command:```bash
redwoodctl policies rollback --name weight-adjust-2029 --to weight-adjust-2028
```

anne: after the rollback and olivia's fallback, probe success rates for eu probes jumped from 73%->96% in the last 45s. 5xx count dropping. Latency medians moving back towards baseline (200ms -> 120ms).

leo: starting DNS/edge purge for eu regional caches to ensure no stale pinning: triggering purge for edge-caches eu-* and pushing a short TTL (60s) temporarily.

sam: opening SEV ticket (SEV-2029) with timeline, affected customers, and mitigation steps. Drafting external comms for impacted customers.

olivia: handing off to leo for monitoring and follow-up. I'm out for a scheduled window in 30m; will join async. @leo please continue watch and add follow-up tasks.

leo: ack — continuing monitoring. I'll keep probes on 15s cadence, watch 5xx rate, and coordinate with infra to run a targeted canary for text-gen-v2 in eu-west1. Adding a short runbook note: "If probe-weight miscalc observed again: disable steering -> rollback policy -> flush edge TTLs -> escalate to infra for deeper probe-metric dump."

sam: thanks all, adding notes to postmortem and assigning owners. Will schedule a root-cause session tomorrow. :thumbsup:
